headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Experienced Backend Engineer with over 5 years of professional experience in developing scalable server-side solutions. Proven track record in microservices architecture, database optimization, and cloud infrastructure management. Adept at leading system migrations and improving API performance within high-traffic fintech and health-tech environments.

experiences.title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Lead the migration of legacy monolithic payment processing modules to a distributed microservices architecture using Go and gRPC.
Optimized PostgreSQL query performance, resulting in a 40% reduction in API response times for health analytics reporting.
Mentored junior developers on best practices for RESTful API design and secure coding standards.
Integrated automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to reduce deployment cycles by 30%.

experiences.title: Backend Developer
description: Developed core backend services for mobile banking applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Managed high-concurrency transaction processing systems, ensuring 99.9% uptime during peak load periods.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to implement secure authentication protocols (OAuth2/JWT).
Maintained and scaled internal data warehouses using Redis for caching frequently accessed user data.
